title: exallage angustifolia
intro: Exallage angustifolia, commonly known as the exallage, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Exallage angustifolia are attributed to its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and analgesic properties, which help in reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
